seeded_skills.name: Document Editor (DOCX)
seeded_skills.description: Criação e edição de documentos Word com Claude. Gera relatórios formatados, edita templates e extrai campos de formulários.
seeded_skills.long_description: Document creation and editing skill for Word files (.docx) that powers Claude's document capabilities. Supports generating formatted reports, editing templates, and extracting form fields. Integrates with Claude's native document processing pipeline.

seeded_skills.name: PDF Extractor & Generator
seeded_skills.description: Leitura, extração e geração de arquivos PDF. Resume PDFs longos ou gera novos com conteúdo estruturado.
seeded_skills.long_description: Document creation and editing skill for PDF files, capable of tasks like extracting form fields, reading content from scanned PDFs, and generating new PDF documents with structured layouts. Supports text extraction and form automation.

seeded_skills.name: Spreadsheet Analyzer (XLSX)
seeded_skills.description: Análise e criação de planilhas Excel. Lê dados, gera gráficos e formata tabelas automaticamente.
seeded_skills.long_description: Document creation and editing skill for Excel files (.xlsx). Supports reading spreadsheet data, generating charts, formatting tables, and creating new workbooks with calculated data. Integrates with Claude's document processing.

seeded_skills.name: Presentation Generator (PPTX)
seeded_skills.description: Cria apresentações PowerPoint a partir de texto. Gera slides com títulos, bullets e layouts profissionais.
seeded_skills.long_description: Document creation and editing skill for PowerPoint files (.pptx). Creates presentations from text descriptions, generates slides with titles, bullet points, and professional layouts. Supports template-based generation.

seeded_skills.name: Notion Workspace Manager
seeded_skills.description: Integração com Notion via skill parceira. Cria páginas, databases e gerencia workspaces diretamente pelo Claude.
seeded_skills.long_description: Partner skill designed to teach Claude how to better use Notion. Creates pages, manages databases, organizes workspaces, and automates content workflows. Integrates Notion's API with Claude's native capabilities.

seeded_skills.name: AI Web Search
seeded_skills.description: Busca na internet em tempo real para agentes de IA. Recupera informações, notícias e dados atualizados.
seeded_skills.long_description: Allows AI agents to perform real-time internet searches to retrieve information and current data. Supports multiple search engines, filters results by relevance, and returns structured data. Essential for agents that need up-to-date context.

seeded_skills.name: File System Manager
seeded_skills.description: Operações completas de arquivo: leitura, escrita, criação, manipulação de diretórios e organização de projetos.
seeded_skills.long_description: Enables AI agents to read, write, create, and manipulate files and directories on the system. Supports text files, binary files, directory traversal, and project organization. Essential for development automation.

seeded_skills.name: API Integration Hub
seeded_skills.description: Conecta agentes de IA a APIs de terceiros. Gerencia autenticação, rate limiting e tratamento de erros.
seeded_skills.long_description: Facilitates connection and interaction with third-party services, platforms, and endpoints via programming interfaces. Handles authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and response parsing. Supports REST, GraphQL, and webhook integrations.

seeded_skills.name: Database Query Engine
seeded_skills.description: Consulta, inserção e gerenciamento de dados em bancos SQL e NoSQL. Suporta MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB e Redis.
seeded_skills.long_description: Allows AI agents to query, insert, and manage data in relational and non-relational databases. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and other popular engines. Handles connection pooling, prepared statements, and secure access patterns.

seeded_skills.name: Claude Skills Showcase
seeded_skills.description: Coleção completa de exemplos demonstrando o sistema de skills do Claude em múltiplos workflows: criativo, técnico, enterprise.
seeded_skills.long_description: Plugin/skill set containing a broad range of examples demonstrating Claude's skills system across multiple workflows. Covers Creative & Design (branding, copywriting), Development & Technical (code review, API design), and Enterprise & Communication (report generation, email automation). Ideal for learning the capabilities of Claude skills.

notes.autogpt: AutoGPT não lista plugins individuais no README principal. O projeto é um framework de agentes autônomos, não um marketplace de skills. Não há endpoint público de downloads por plugin.
notes.priority: Skills do Anthropic foram priorizadas pois são oficiais e validadas pela Anthropic. Skills do Cline foram selecionadas por serem as 4 capacidades mais genéricas e úteis.
notes.auto_activate: Todas as skills estão com is_active=false. Devem ser ativadas após validação manual ou score >= 0.8.
